一旦前超光速社会的觉醒度达到上限，我们就无法再观察他们了。相反地，我们可以采取外交行动与他们接触。若干涉政策允许，我们也可提早现身。
texts.en:
Our new Observation Post has come online and will proceed with its Mission as long as the £awareness£ Awareness of the object of our study stays low.

Once a Pre-FTL society reaches maximum awareness, they will no longer be observable. Instead, we will be able to engage them with Diplomatic Actions. We may choose to reveal ourselves early if our Interference Policies allow it.

texts.zh:
我们的新观测站上线了。只要我们研究目标的£awareness£觉醒度保持低位，它就会继续执行任务。

我们能持续地从观测站获得一条独特的科技树，即观测洞见，直到这个前超光速社会的觉醒度达到上限而导致任务终止时。

若是此类情况发生，我们可以取而代之采取外交行动与他们接触。若干涉政策允许，我们也可提早现身。
texts.en:
Our new Observation Post has come online and will proceed with its Mission as long as the £awareness£ Awareness of the object of our study stays low.

We will gain Observation Insights, a unique line of technology, from this outpost until the Pre-FTL society reaches max awareness when missions will be disabled. Instead, we will be able to engage them with Diplomatic Actions.

We could choose to reveal ourselves early if our Interference Policies allow it.
